title: Portfolio in-progress work
description: Provisional metrics for in-flight work on unmerged branches. Written by hand; managed via `drift promote`. Values surface on the public site only for entries with visibility: 'public', and only until the branch lands and `drift sync` picks up the real numbers.

inProgress.description: Keyed by project slug (matches ProjectSlug in types.ts).

InProgressEntry.description: In-progress work tracking for one project. Records the branch carrying the work, its promotion pipeline, site visibility, and the specific metrics to surface provisionally.

branch.description: The branch carrying the in-progress work. Must be pipeline[0].

pipeline.description: Ordered promotion stages: [sourceBranch, ..., mergeTarget]. The work advances through these stages; graduation is detected via git merge-base --is-ancestor.

visibility.description: 'public' — provisional values surface on the portfolio site. 'local' — tracked by the CLI only, never shown publicly.

tracked.description: Metric fields to surface provisionally, keyed by field name (must match a ProjectMetrics / SyncedSource field). Each entry carries the branch value and the baseline on the merge target for context.

TrackedField.description: A single provisionally-tracked metric. value = count on the working branch; baseOnMain = the same metric at the merge target, for context.

value.description: The provisional metric value on the in-progress branch.

baseOnMain.description: The same metric at the merge target (the baseline the branch diverged from).
